issues.description: The problem statement/UML requires Farm.printFarmSong() as the public method to output the "Old MacDonald" song, but both template and reference solution instead expose the public method as Farm.singFarmSong(). Students following the specification may implement/call printFarmSong(), while the starter code (and likely tests based on it) uses singFarmSong(), causing confusion about the required API and potential grading mismatches.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the public song method name consistent across all artifacts: either rename `singFarmSong()` to `printFarmSong()` in template and solution (and update any calls/comments), or update the problem statement/UML to require `singFarmSong()` instead of `printFarmSong()`.
